remarks: Luxury living at its finest. Park Tower 35th floor Penthouse Duplex boasting living room with wall of glass overlooking Mill River Park and Long Island Sound for Spectacular Sunset Views! The dynamic, open floor plan for entertaining, and everyday living. The Grand living room opens to a spacious terrace. Host a dinner party in the oversized dining area, cozy up for movie night in the family room. A gourmet chef's dream, the luxury kitchen offers Wolf appliances and honed marble counters and custom cabinetry. The marble staircase leads to the 34th flr sophisticated Primary suite, with marble bath, two walk-in closets, and balcony. Two more BRs with en-suite bathrooms. Rent Parking at Garage in Building 2 Cars Tandem $332/m. Relax with 24/7 Concierge, All Season Indoor Pool, Fitness Center, Lounge, Rooftop lounge with Grills.
